title: Feeding the Five Thousand Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Feeding of the Five Thousand Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Feeding the Five Thousand Bible crossword: five barley loaves, two small fishes, and twelve baskets of fragments. KJV clues, free on iOS.
prose: A great multitude on a mountain, no food for miles, and a lad with five barley loaves and two small fishes — but what are they among so many? Feeding the Five Thousand makes a grid of John 6: the sitting down on the grass, the giving of thanks, and the twelve baskets filled with what was left over.
The numbers do most of the work in this puzzle, which makes it a friendly one to solve. The closing verse is the disciple's own doubtful arithmetic, just before it stops applying.

clues.text: Grain the loaves were made of
Baskets of fragments taken up afterward
How many loaves the lad had

verseText: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?
